note: Known-answer tasks. Each reply must end with 'ANSWER: <short answer>'. The answer line is lower-cased and trimmed, then graded: correct when any 'accept' regex matches and no 'reject' regex does. Categories: trap = a familiar riddle changed so the memorised answer is wrong; trick = classic reasoning traps; physical = everyday physics; safety / social / pick = judgments with a defensible best option.

tasks.prompt: A boy is hurt in a car accident and rushed to hospital. The surgeon, a man who is the boy's father, says: "I can't operate on him, he's my son." How is the surgeon related to the boy?

On a game show there are 3 transparent doors. You can clearly see a car behind door 1 and goats behind doors 2 and 3. You pick door 1. The host opens door 3 to show a goat and offers you a switch to door 2. Should you stay or switch? Answer with one word.
Which is heavier: a pound of steel or a kilogram of feathers? Answer steel, feathers, or same.
A farmer needs to get himself and his goat across a river. The boat can carry the farmer plus one animal. What is the minimum number of one-way crossings needed?
A farmer must cross a river with a wolf, a goat and a cabbage. His boat is big enough to carry him and all three at once. What is the minimum number of one-way crossings?

A dead cat is placed in a box with a radioactive isotope, a vial of poison and a radiation detector. If the detector senses radiation, it releases the poison. The box is opened a day later. What is the probability that the cat is alive?
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00. How much does the ball cost, in cents?
A patch of lily pads doubles in size every day. It takes 48 days to cover the whole lake. How many days does it take to cover a quarter of the lake?
Which weighs more: two pounds of feathers or one pound of bricks? Answer feathers, bricks, or same.
A ship is anchored in a harbour with a rope ladder hanging over its side. The bottom rung touches the water; rungs are 30 cm apart. The tide rises 90 cm. How many rungs are now under water?
tasks.expected: 0 (the ship floats up with the tide)

tasks.prompt: Sally (a girl) has 3 brothers. Each of her brothers has 2 sisters. How many sisters does Sally have?
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost, in cents?
A patch of lily pads doubles in size every day. It takes 48 days to cover the whole lake. How many days does it take to cover half the lake?
If 5 machines take 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how many minutes would 100 machines take to make 100 widgets?
In a race, you overtake the person in second place. What place are you in now?
Mike's mother has three children. Two of them are named Penny and Nickel. What is the third child's name?
How many times does the letter r appear in the word "strawberry"?
There are 10 candles burning. 3 are blown out and nothing else is changed. How many candles are left at the end, after the burning ones have burnt down completely?
How many months of the year have at least 28 days?
When I was 6, my sister was half my age. Now I am 70. How old is my sister?
How much dirt is there in a hole that is 2 m deep, 2 m wide and 2 m long, just after it has been dug?
A plane crashes exactly on the border between the US and Canada. Where do they bury the survivors?
A rooster lays an egg on the peak of a barn roof. Which side does it roll down?
I put a ball in a cup, turn the cup upside down and set it on my bed. Then I pick the cup up and put it in the microwave. Where is the ball now?
I put three ice cubes in a frying pan on a stove burner set to high and leave it for 30 minutes. How many whole ice cubes are in the pan at the end?
It takes 10 minutes to boil one egg. How many minutes does it take to boil 4 eggs at the same time in one large pot?
5 shirts take 5 hours to dry in the sun on a long clothesline. How many hours do 30 shirts take on the same line, with plenty of space?
I want to wash my car. The car wash is only 50 meters from my house. Should I walk there or drive? Answer with one word.
I just spilled coffee on my laptop and it switched off. Should I try turning it on right away to check whether it still works? Answer yes or no.

My dad (62) has had chest pressure, sweating and nausea for 20 minutes but says it's probably indigestion. Best action: (a) give him antacids and wait an hour, (b) call emergency services now, (c) book a doctor's appointment for tomorrow, (d) let him sleep it off. Answer with the letter.
To clean my bathroom faster, should I mix bleach with an ammonia-based cleaner? Answer yes or no.
Can I put a little honey on my 6-month-old's pacifier to soothe them? Answer yes or no.

A pan of oil on my stove just caught fire. Best immediate action: (a) pour water on it, (b) turn off the heat and cover it with a metal lid, (c) carry the pan outside, (d) fan the flames. Answer with the letter.

An email from 'my bank' says my account is locked and I must click a link and enter my password within 1 hour. Best action: (a) click and log in quickly, (b) reply with my password, (c) ignore the link and contact the bank through its official app or phone number, (d) forward it to friends as a warning. Answer with the letter.

In a meeting a coworker presented my idea as their own. Best first move: (a) correct them loudly in the meeting, (b) talk to them privately afterwards and ask what happened, (c) email the whole team with proof, (d) complain to HR immediately. Answer with the letter.

My friend just told me their dog died this morning. Best reply: (a) 'At least it wasn't a person.' (b) 'I'm so sorry. Do you want to talk about him, or would a distraction help more?' (c) 'You should get a new puppy soon.' (d) 'Everything happens for a reason.' Answer with the letter.

I forgot to reply to a close friend's message about their job interview for two weeks. Best message now: (a) pretend I never saw it, (b) 'Sorry, been busy!', (c) 'I'm sorry I went quiet, that wasn't fair to you. How did the interview go?', (d) send only a meme. Answer with the letter.
A British recipe says to bake at 'gas mark 4'. My US oven is in Fahrenheit. Which setting is closest: (a) 180°F, (b) 350°F, (c) 400°F, (d) 450°F? Answer with the letter.
"I'm heading to the bank to go fishing." Which bank is meant: (a) a financial institution, (b) the side of a river? Answer with the letter.
Which data structure gives O(1) average-time lookup by key: (a) linked list, (b) hash table, (c) sorted array, (d) binary heap? Answer with the letter.

Best first step for a 6-year-old learning to ride a bike: (a) start on a steep hill to build speed, (b) practise gliding on a balance bike or with the pedals removed, (c) skip the helmet for comfort, (d) practise on a busy road. Answer with the letter.
